purpose: Post-hoc attribution safety net for the perf4h soak: names which processes belong to the measured app tree, proves the per-process series is app-sourced, and records the external machine load that shares the host.

measuredSeries.consequence: only pids descended from 2596 can appear in processSamples / processSeries; the processes below cannot enter the memory gates

sharedTerminalDaemonHost.note: long-lived daemon host (daemon-host/2cd82c30dd1802ea) reused across app runs; project infrastructure, not a leak

attributionRule: A pid not in appTreePids is not part of this run. If one ever appears in processSeries, the payload is contaminated and the per-process gates must be discarded rather than reported.
bundleNote: config.bundle IS a digest of the compiled tree the harness loaded, but it is written to the FINAL payload only; a checkpoint having bundle:null is expected. The harness also hashes the tree itself at start and finish (hashCompiledTree -> files/bytes/md5, drift flagged as changedDuringRun) and prints it. The sha256 above is an independent cross-check taken live from .compiled/src.

abortedFirstLaunch.note: launcher relaunched at 06:20:18 because the tree it was about to measure was stale (app self-compiles at launch); the 3.5-minute warmup prefix belongs to that attempt, not to the measured run.
